name: copernicus
description: GPT-only Fleet, adaptive SAS+OKF auto-research, and Rick Rubin subtraction for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Copernicus combines bounded Sol, Terra, and Luna fleets with adaptive problem-solving graphs, locally integrity-checked evidence, OKF cycle memory, and Rick Rubin subtraction.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Copernicus to frame this problem, invent the smallest useful GPT-only agent graph, execute it with evidence, and cut anything that does not earn its place.
